body:
GoogleAuthHandler/AgentAuthHandler both gain an optional, nil-safe EventLog field and a shared emitAuthEvent helper (fire-and-forget, same precedent as apples.go's syncAppleToGit -- logging failures never break the real auth flow). Four real emission points: google.failure/success, agent.failure/success. Agent failure events log the attempted agent_name only, never the raw agent_secret -- verified by a real test. main.go wires unifiedLog into both handlers by pointer once it exists. New TestAgentAuthHandler_EmitsEvents. Verified with both go build/test and GOWORK=off go build/test (the real CI path). Zero regressions. commits aaafcb7, f6f61ac.

⚓ ☃
title: S226-02 -- real auth events wired into the unified logging backend
